articles.summary: Building Recognized by the Greater Minneapolis Building Owners and Managers Association Inland American Office Management LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc., announced today that its IDS Center was awarded with The Outstanding Building of the Year (TOBY) Award, presented by the Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) of Greater Minneapolis. The IDS Center took the top spot in the competitions Over 1 Million Square Feet category for the third year in a row. The IDS Center, Minneapolis, Minnesota (Photo: Business Wire) The IDS Center is synonymous with some of the most distinguished and influential companies and leaders in Minneapolis, said Jim Durda, vice president of Inland American Office Management LLC and general manager of the IDS Center. articles.title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc.’s IDS Center Wins Regional Outstanding Building Award for Third Year in a Row
